home.title: Rumbo operations
home.content: Manage the main frontend CRUD modules from this dashboard.

main.title: Students
main.subtitle: Manage students associated to your account.
main.transportHint: Registering a student does not share their data with any driver. Use Request transport to send a request to the driver; once accepted, the driver can include the student in a school route.

authorize.title: Authorize tutor
authorize.description: Enter the profile ID of a registered tutor and define their relationship with the student.
authorize.tutorProfileIdError: Enter a valid tutor profile ID.

detail.description: Manage the student's information and authorizations.
detail.deletionPending: There is a pending data deletion request.
detail.deletionHint: You can request the deletion of the student's personal data.
detail.notFound: The student is not among the students linked to your profile.

list.searchPlaceholder: Search by route name or code
list.emptyHint: Try another filter or create a route.

form.requiredFields: Review the required fields before saving.
form.scheduleIncomplete: Choose a service day and enter its departure time.
form.scheduleSaved: Recurring schedule confirmed in the saved configuration.
form.vehicleIdHint: Choose a vehicle from your registered fleet. Verification of ownership requires IAM.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.paragraph1: Rumbo is an academic software project. Use of the application is subject to the rules, permissions and responsibilities defined for the service.
terms.paragraph2: Personal and operational information must be used only for school transportation management.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.paragraph1: Rumbo treats personal information as part of an academic software project and limits its use to the functions represented in the application.
privacy.paragraph2: Production use requires privacy, security and legal review before processing real personal data.
